heroHeadline: US Halts Patriot Deliveries to Ukraine; Zelensky Says Move Favours Putin
heroSubtitle: A hours-long drone raid on Kyiv on Nov 19 killed one person, injured five and damaged the Dutch and Austrian embassies and St. Volodymyr's Cathedral. Ukraine's Air Force counted 98 drones plus Onyx missiles overnight, after Ukrainian strikes on the Kerch Bridge on Nov 17.
